BiblicalUsage: Jeberechiah is named once, as the father of Zechariah, whom Isaiah took as a faithful witness to record the word of the LORD. His son's name is written down, and his own is kept beside it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God remembers the fathers of His witnesses, and Jeberechiah is kept because his son was faithful.
